title: Ex 33: While Loops
checklist: 改几个数字/字符串再跑
body:
# Ex 33 · While Loops

`while`：条件为真就重复。注意更新循环变量，避免死循环。

## 目标
- 用 while 填充列表
- 对比等效的 for/range 写法

## 自检
- [ ] i 每次都会增加
- [ ] 列表长度符合预期

starterFiles.ex33.py:
i = 0
numbers = []

while i < 6:
    print(f"At the top i is {i}")
    numbers.append(i)
    i = i + 1
    print("Numbers now:", numbers)
    print(f"At the bottom i is {i}")

print("The numbers:")
for num in numbers:
    print(num)
